description: Voies ferrées 3D is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Représentation géométrique et conventionnelle du système ferroviaire pour des fins de planification. Ces données géospatiales sont structurées selon les couches d’informations suivantes; - CARTO-FER-ACCESSOIRE: barrière de passage à niveau & lanterne de passe à niveau - CARTO-FER-DEBARCADERE: quai pour l’embarquement / débarquement de marchandises ou passagers - CARTO-FER-PONT: ouvrage d’art ferroviaire permettant de franchir un ... Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are PoleARTM, SIRR, chemin de fer, voie ferrée. It offers 2 resource(s) in GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
